# folk | Product Overview

folk is a collaborative relationship CRM that integrates contacts, email, calendar, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn workflows into a flexible pipeline. The product core creates a unified workspace around customer relationships, sales execution and revenue processes, reducing dispersed tools and manual maintenance.
